name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A compound avatar component with image, text, placeholder, status indicator, brand logo, and notification support. Uses namespace exports: Avatar.Root, Avatar.Image, Avatar.Indicator, Avatar.Status, Avatar.BrandLogo, Avatar.Notification.

docs.lead: A compound avatar component with image, text, placeholder, status indicator, brand logo, and notification support.

examples.title: Color
examples.description: Avatar backgrounds in different colors: gray (default), yellow, blue, sky, purple, and red.

examples.title: Text
examples.description: Pass text children (e.g. initials) instead of an image.

examples.title: Placeholder
examples.description: When no children are provided, a placeholder icon is shown. Use placeholderType to switch between user and company icons.

examples.title: Status
examples.description: Show user status (online, offline, busy, away) using Avatar.Indicator and Avatar.Status.

examples.title: Notification
examples.description: Show a notification dot using Avatar.Indicator with position='top' and Avatar.Notification.

examples.title: Brand Logo
examples.description: Show a brand logo using Avatar.Indicator with position='bottom' and Avatar.BrandLogo.

examples.title: Custom SVG Indicator
examples.description: Pass any custom SVG or component as children to Avatar.Indicator for custom badges like verified icons.

examples.title: As Link
examples.description: Use the asChild prop with Radix Slot to render the avatar as a link or other element.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the avatar in pixels

props.name: placeholderType
props.description: The placeholder icon type when no children are provided

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders as child element using Radix Slot

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders as child element using Radix Slot

api.name: Avatar.Indicator
api.description: Positioned container for status, notification, or brand logo overlays.

api.name: Avatar.Status
api.description: A colored dot indicating user status.

api.name: Avatar.BrandLogo
api.description: A small circular brand logo overlay.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders as child element using Radix Slot
